comments.value: Its very important to know if someone has earmuffs on? Thats crazy that they intentionally removed it

@{62def692e106a844b4e464c0|full_name} yes it is, imagine approaching someone, talking to them and then finding out that they could not hear you, this could lead to drama and it will be harder to moderate instances

*feels strongly about this*

Fix it!

Stop removing accessibility features!!!

Seeing an earmuff mode icon is a visual cue that I need to be close to the person to be heard.

The alternative to actually seeing this is just literally standing on top of every single person you want to talk to in order to make sure you are heard, which is not a better experience for the person talking or the person who has earmuffs mode.

@{60411ec5cc01c21febdcbe37|full_name} Imagine those people who wont directly talk to you but will say something 6ft away expecting you to respond, but you dont, so they get pissed off and come yell at you.

OR alternatively:

> Be me

> Shy af

> Might say something quietly

> Ignored (due to earmuffs)

> Be sad and leave, ruining friendships
This new update is entirely uneeded

I think earmuff mode should be visible but it should not be visible if a user has muted you. Making self moderation publicly visible just encourages harassment from others. Actually have had to deal with this before with the current system
@{65d54028598d756cc0b39f6d|full_name} I disagree, I think it's pretty important to know if a user has muted you as well. This is another feature they removed with the new nameplates update.
Well, It's not exactly what I wanted but it's better than nothing at all

The earmuff icon is back on the expanded nameplate when someone has the mode turned on. 

We're still looking at some of the other feedback, including making it visible in non-expanded mode. No news there yet, but keep an eye out.

details: According to another canny post, the new nameplates have had the earmuff mode icon functionality intentionally left out of the redesign. This is a baffling decision to me as I think it's important to know if a user you're interacting with has earmuff mode enabled or not, just as important as it is to know if they have you muted or themselves deafened or not. I think this feature should be added back into the new nameplates.
title: [1878] New nameplates should have the earmuff mode icon for users with earmuff mode enabled
